title: The Lift to the Glowing Orchard

breakdown.title: The Lift to the Glowing Orchard
breakdown.logline: A dreamer rides an old brass lift with a friend who becomes a child again, then steps into a dusk orchard where apples glow and a white horse waits.

colours.value: brassy golds, dusky blues, soft apple glow

texture.value: polished metal, old wood, warm skin

breakdown.world_logic: A tiny lift can rise for far too long, a friend can become a child unnoticed, and an orchard at dusk can grow apples that glow like lamps.

identity.value: the dreamer's best friend from school
a white horse in the orchard

geography.value: tiny lift with brass walls and a little folding gate

landmarks.value: brass walls, folding gate; appearance brass walls and a folding gate

geography.value: orchard at dusk, apple trees in rows

landmarks.value: appearance orchard at dusk with apple trees in rows, every apple glowing softly like a lamp

moments.action: The dreamer and Tomas as adults stand in the tiny lift with brass walls and a folding gate, going up for too long.
moments.visual_point: the brass walls and folding gate
moments.dream: the lift goes up for way too long

moments.action: Tomas is now about ten, wearing their old school uniform, standing as if nothing is off.
moments.visual_point: Tomas as a child in school uniform
moments.dream: Tomas changed from an adult to a child and didn't notice

moments.action: The lift stops and the folding gate opens on its own to reveal an orchard at dusk.
moments.looks_at: the open gate and orchard beyond
moments.visual_point: the gate open to the orchard
moments.dream: the gate opens on its own

moments.action: The dreamer steps out into the orchard at dusk with apple trees in rows, every apple glowing softly like a lamp.
moments.shift: the lift opens to an orchard instead of a corridor
moments.dream: the lift opened into an orchard, not a corridor

moments.action: Tomas as a child runs ahead between the trees, disappearing down a row.
A white horse stands very still in the middle of the orchard.
The horse lowers its head and the dreamer touches its nose; it is warm.
moments.looks_at: the horse's head and the dreamer's hand

words: oh hey! it's weird, I keep thinking about the lift with the brass walls and the little folding gate. the whole dream started there I think.
I don't really remember stepping in, just being in it. it was tiny. and going up for way too long.
no, Tomas was with me. my best friend from school. we were both adults at first.
yeah. I looked at him again and he was about ten, in our old school uniform. he didn't seem to notice anything was off.
just stared I think. then the lift stopped and the gate opened.
it opened and instead of a corridor there was an orchard, at dusk. apple trees in rows, and every apple was glowing softly like a lamp.
I think I must have stepped out. Tomas ran ahead between the trees.
I don't think so. there was a white horse standing in the middle of the orchard, very still.
maybe. I went over and it lowered its head so I could touch its nose. it was warm.
